card.name: Words linking a product to its companion
card.fires_on: Linking words that come right after a drug, booklet or kit name and lead into a companion item or co-use, such as included, enclosed, when, are, with. It also fires partway through brand names.

modes.label: Enclosed with the product
modes.description: Words like included or enclosed after instructions-for-use or kit mentions, pointing to what comes with the package.
modes.example: See the ZYNRELEF Instructions for Use<< included>> in the kit for complete administration instructions with

modes.label: Used together with another drug
modes.description: Linking words after a drug name that lead into coadministration or association with another drug.
modes.example: MPA plasma concentrations may be decreased when mycophenolic acid delayed-release tablets<< are>> coadministered with cyclosp

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Middle pieces of brand or drug names such as Opfolda, WELIREG or norepinephrine.
modes.example: If vomiting occurs any time after taking<< W>>ELIREG, do not retake

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like associated, accompanying and related, so the text moves on to another word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says something comes with or is used together with a product.
